subject: Bridge fee waiver & staggered billing for trial top-up
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@apexlytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@apexlytics.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — bridge fee & staggered invoicing for pilot top-up

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is happy with the latency numbers. We hit an internal blocker: the pilot is coming up against capacity and procurement is asking for an official top-up and a billing cadence they can sign off on. Two asks from our side:

- Can Redwood waive the $7,500 bridge/activation fee for this mid-pilot top-up?
- Can invoices be staggered (50% upfront / 50% on completion) rather than a single invoice? Also need Net30 terms.

If you can waive the fee and accept staggered billing, procurement will sign the SOW amendment and we can commit to a conversion conversation within 60 days. I copied Procurement to loop them in.

Appreciate a quick confirmation — we’re on a tight timeline.

Best,
Alex Turner
Head of AI Product
Apexlytics

----
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@apexlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — bridge fee & staggered invoicing for pilot top-up

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: we can be flexible, but I want to give you two concrete options so procurement can pick one quickly. Attached: a short proposal matrix.

Option A — Top-up credits (faster to execute)
- Extend current timebox by 3 weeks.
- Top-up credits: $18,000 (consumable during extended pilot).
- Bridge/activation fee waived if you sign SOW amendment and confirm conversion review within 60 days of pilot end.
- Billing: Net30, invoice full amount upfront (credit balance issued) or we can do 60/40 if needed.

Option B — Voucher + staggered billing (procurement-friendly)
- Issue a $18,500 voucher with 50/50 invoicing (50% invoice at amendment signature, 50% invoiced at pilot close).
- We offer a 15% one-time credit if you convert to a Reserved purchase within 60 days.
- Bridge/activation fee: waived only if voucher path is chosen and procurement signs the amendment.

If neither option matches your procurement constraints, tell me what exact payment splits and discounts they need and I’ll loop in Ben and Marissa for approval.

Sooj
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: TopUp_Proposal_Apexlytics.pdf (application/pdf)

----
From: Procurement <procurement@apexlytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — bridge fee & staggered invoicing for pilot top-up

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the options. Procurement preferences:
- Full waiver of the bridge/activation fee (we don’t want conditional waivers).
- Net30 on all invoices.
- Preferred invoicing schedule: 50% at amendment signature, 25% mid-extended pilot milestone, 25% at pilot completion.
- We need the SOW amendment updated to show the new milestone dates and acceptance criteria (our legal will countersign).

If Redwood can grant a firm full-waiver and accept the 50/25/25 billing, we’ll sign the amendment today.

Alex is copied.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
Apexlytics

----
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement <procurement@apexlytics.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — bridge fee & staggered invoicing for pilot top-up

Hi all,

Appreciate the context. I can make a recommendation to approve a concession but need Marissa to sign off on the total economic impact. Proposed internal concession that balances risk:

- Offer a one-time activation credit of $5,000 (applied to invoice) in place of a full $7,500 waiver.
- Approve the 50/25/25 invoice schedule (Net30) to match procurement’s preference.
- Extend pilot by 3 weeks with milestone acceptance at week 2 of extension.
- If Apexlytics converts to Reserved capacity within 45 days after pilot close, Redwood will provide a 12% conversion credit on their first reserved invoice.

This keeps some skin in the game for both sides while giving procurement the cadence they need. Marissa — can you approve the $5k credit and the 12% conversion credit? If not, what lift do we need?

Thanks,
Ben
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — bridge fee & staggered invoicing for pilot top-up

Ben — approved but with a small tweak. Approve the $5k activation credit and the 50/25/25 Net30 schedule. Extend pilot by 3 weeks. Make the conversion incentive 12% but only if the conversion is executed within 45 days and total committed spend is >= $50k. We should also require a short mutual action plan with milestone dates before signing.

I’m ok with the financial concession for this strategic account — close quickly.

Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

----
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@apexlytics.com>, Procurement <procurement@apexlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Final: agreed terms for top-up amendment and invoicing cadence

Alex / Procurement — thanks for the fast back-and-forth. Confirming the agreed terms below so your legal/procurement team can sign the amendment:

- SOW amendment to extend current pilot by 3 weeks; milestone acceptance at week 2 of extension.
- Invoice schedule: 50% at amendment signature, 25% mid-extension milestone, 25% at pilot completion. All invoices Net30.
- Activation concession: one-time $5,000 credit applied to the first invoice (in lieu of full fee waiver).
- Conversion incentive: 12% credit on first Reserved invoice if Apexlytics converts within 45 days post-pilot and commits >= $50,000.
- Mutual action plan required and attached.

I attached the SOW amendment and the short mutual action plan. Please review and sign via DocuSign link below. Once countersigned we’ll issue the first invoice per the 50% schedule and apply the $5k credit.

Attachments: SOW-Amendment-POC.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document), MutualActionPlan.pdf (application/pdf)

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234

Looking forward to closing this out today.

Best,
Sooj
